name: antara

scripts.build:extension: tsc && tsc -p extension/tsconfig.json && vite build -c vite.extension.config.ts --mode extension && node scripts/extension-check.mjs --production
scripts.desktop:build: node -e "process.env.VITE_API_BASE ||= 'https://antara.tech'; console.log('Packaged desktop API: ' + process.env.VITE_API_BASE); process.exit(require('node:child_process').spawnSync('tauri', ['build', ...process.argv.slice(1)], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }).status ?? 1)" --
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/check-test-globs.mjs test:unit && tsx --import ./scripts/test-asset-stub.mjs --test src/platform/*.test.ts src/solares/*.test.ts src/solares/vaults/*.test.ts src/solares/transfers/*.test.ts src/solares/wallet/*.test.ts src/solares/relay/*.test.ts src/solares/paired/*.test.ts src/solares/layers/*.test.ts src/solares/ui/*.test.ts src/solares/shell/*.test.ts src/solares/home/*.test.ts src/solares/receive/*.test.ts src/solares/addressbook/*.test.ts src/solares/activity/*.test.ts src/solares/verification/*.test.ts src/solares/settings/*.test.ts src/solares/transfers/send/*.test.ts src/solares/relay/ui/*.test.ts src/solares/download/*.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:config && npm --prefix server test
scripts.test:config: node scripts/check-test-globs.mjs test:config && node --test scripts/doctor.test.mjs scripts/check-privy.test.mjs scripts/provision-guardian.test.mjs scripts/check-desktop-build.test.mjs scripts/extension-check.test.mjs scripts/check-test-globs.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:desktop && npm run build

description: Solana-primary multichain wallet with independent multisig vaults
